thread:
Sam Lee: Heads up — p99 for /v1/generate jumped to ~1.1s around 03:10 after yesterday's routing warmup tweak. p50/p95 look fine.
Maria Chen: saw alert too. Any breakdown by variant?
Aj Patel: quick query shows most traffic fine, but model-small variant p99 ~1.2s on a few routes. sample counts tiny though.
Sam Lee: exact pattern I see — tiny population but big tail, so aggregate p99 nudged. Not a global regression.
Leo: could be cold KV cache + queuing on a slow pool. small variant sits on shared low-priority nodes.
Maria Chen: console currently only shows per-endpoint p50/p95/p99 aggregated. hard to spot low-volume tails. can we surface provenance (fallback vs primary vs fanout) in the latency panel?
Aj Patel: propose adding a lightweight tag `route_provenance` with values: primary, fallback, fanout-member. Router sets header X-Route-Provenance when rewriting.
Sam Lee: +1. Also need to distinguish sampling source (gateway-sampled vs server-sampled) so users judge signal quality.
Leo: implementation notes: header plumbing + telemetry tag. don't let provenance header affect cache keys accidentally.
Maria Chen: UX idea: toggle "breakdown by provenance" in latency view (off by default). when on, show per-variant p50/p95/p99 as small bars with sample counts and a provenance legend.
Sam Lee: alerting tweak: include sample_count in p99 alerts or let alert ignore spikes under a threshold (configurable). Yesterday's page had count=7 but no context.
Aj Patel: pipeline note: our gateway sampling + ingestion sampling differ. propagate `sample_source` tag with values gateway|ingestion so console can annotate.
Sam Lee: pseudo router change:```yaml
- if fallback: set-header: X-Route-Provenance: fallback
- if fanout: set-header: X-Route-Provenance: fanout-member
- else: set-header: X-Route-Provenance: primary
```
Leo: telemetry ingestion should attach provenance_source=router and sample_source=gateway when present. I'll make sure not to change existing metrics aggregation semantics.
Maria Chen: effort estimate?
Aj Patel: router change + header ~1d, ingestion + tag propagate ~2d, console toggle + smallbars ~2-3d, alerting update ~1d. 6-7d parallelized.
Sam Lee: plan: canary on chat-completions route first. also add note to rollout docs about interpreting low-sample p99s.
ObservabilityBot: alert: p99 /v1/generate > 1s — count=9, provenance=fallback (auto post).
Maria Chen: thanks — tagging @eng-sre for capacity implications. :thumbsup:
